name: com.mylogoqr/qr-generator
title: MyLogoQR Free QR Code Generator
description: Enterprise-grade, 100% client-side QR code generator and diagnostic suite with custom logo embedding, gradient styling, vector SVG/PDF export, and offline camera barcode scanner.

tools.name: generate_qr_code
tools.description: Generate a custom high-resolution QR code with embedded logo, vector SVG/PNG output, custom colors, and error correction.

text.description: The destination URL, Wi-Fi configuration, vCard, or text content to encode.

format.description: Target output graphic format (vector SVG or high-res raster PNG/WebP).

errorCorrectionLevel.description: Reed-Solomon error correction tier. 'H' (30% recovery) allows central logo placement without read failure.

foregroundColor.description: Hexadecimal color code for the QR code body modules.

backgroundColor.description: Hexadecimal color code for the background canvas.

logoUrl.description: Optional direct image URL for central logo placement.

tools.name: scan_qr_code
tools.description: Decode and parse a QR code image file or camera stream client-side without sending data to servers.

imageUrl.description: URL or base64 data URI of the QR code image to decode.

tools.name: check_contrast
tools.description: Calculate the WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio between foreground and background colors to verify scanning reliability.
